name: @serverlessinbox/mailbox-cdk-shared
description: Shared CDK artifact-resolution infrastructure for mailbox packages

scripts.build:inline-handler: node -e "const e=require('esbuild');const r=e.buildSync({entryPoints:['src/track-resolver/handler.ts'],bundle:true,minify:true,format:'cjs',write:false,external:['@aws-sdk/client-s3','aws-lambda','path','https','url'],platform:'node',target:'node20'});const code=r.outputFiles[0].text;const bytes=Buffer.byteLength(code,'utf-8');if(bytes>4096){console.error('FAIL: inline handler is '+bytes+' bytes, exceeds ~4KB limit');process.exit(1)}const fs=require('fs');const dir='src/track-resolver/generated';if(!fs.existsSync(dir))fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(dir+'/track-resolver-handler-source.ts','export const TRACK_RESOLVER_HANDLER_SOURCE = '+JSON.stringify(code)+';\\n');console.log('Generated inline handler: '+bytes+' bytes')"
